question: Who among the following won the Asian Snooker Championship in September 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Pankaj Advani**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pankaj Advani**:

 
 
• Pankaj Advani represented India in the **Asian Snooker Championship 2021** and won by defeating** Amir Sarkhosh** at the** Al Messila Resort** located in **Doha, Qatar** on **16th September 2021**.
 
• He has won this title for a **second consecutive time**.
 
• He is the winner of the** last Asian Snooker Championship held in 2019**. In 2019, Pankaj also became the only player who won the titles in all forms of **billiards, snooker, 6Reds, and 10Reds **competitions.
 
 
 
• **Asian Snooker Championship**:
 
 
• The ACBS Asian Snooker Championship is the premier **non-professional snooker tournament in Asia**.
 
• The event series is sanctioned by the **Asian Confederation of Billiard Sports** and started in **1984**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/410f760361112c1381d16699dc6cdc2e1bd992cefe39123d0e65a0bf1a2c07e7.png] 

 
• Pankaj Advani

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** Babar Masih**:

 
 
• Babar Masih is a **Rawalpindi-based Pakistani amateur snooker player **who represents Pakistan in different international tournaments.
 
• Masih is one of **Pakistan's top-ranked amateur cueists**.
 
 
 
• **Mark Selby**:
 
 
• Mark Anthony Selby is an** English professional snooker player **who is a** four-time World Snooker Champion**. 
 
 
 
• **Amir Sarkhosh**:
 
 
• Amir Sarkhosh is a professional **snooker player **from** Karaj, Iran**.
